description: Based on the British TV cooking show "Come Dine with Me (2005)", five people meet over the course of one week. Every day, one of them prepares a dinner and then invites the others to their home to eat. In the end, the guests rate ...

videos.title: The Call of Home
videos.overview: The Ninja investigate the vengestone operation but end up fighting each other after a humiliating rescue by the New Ninja.

videos.title: Day 5: Antonia, Aschaffenburg
videos.overview: Antonia, 29 years old and from Aschaffenburg, presents a three-course menu. The starter consists of fennel with mussels, the main course of soba with soy sauce, and the dessert of miso with cream.
